column1: # How each AFO term appears in SysML v2 — the mapping between the ontology
# the kgrapher writes (kgrapher/ontologies/afo.ttl) and the library the
# modeler writes (mAF.sysml). mAF is generated from this table and AFO by
# `go generate` (cmd/mafgen); the frame it is generated into, for what AFO
# One row per term AFO declares, plus rows starting with "+" for elements mAF
# needs and AFO has no term for. maf_test.go fails if a term is missing, a row
# names a term AFO does not declare, or mAF.sysml is not what the generator
#   maf          generated into mAF, as the kind, name, owner, type and
#   generated    written by the model generator (mbaigo usecases/smodeling.go,
#                the modeler) rather than declared in the library
#   not-modeled  deliberately left out; the note says why
#   extension    an mAF element with no AFO term ("+name" rows)
# kind: a definition ("abstract part def", "part def", "attribute def",
# "enum def", "abstract port def"), a feature of the owner definitions
# ("attribute", "part"), or an enumeration literal ("enum"). A definition's
# specializations come from AFO's rdfs:subClassOf and its doc from AFO's
# rdfs:comment. An owner may carry its own multiplicity: Owner[0..1].
# Columns are separated by tabs; "-" is empty.
